audit.why: TRICKY at 7/10 with a 7.5/10 carry threat matches a 40% win rate and the prose. Left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart is wrong at three positions in both layers: level 1 is given to 'Skill', level 3 to Kennen, and levels 4-5 to 'Skill'. The packet chart and the matchup's own whys read Kennen / Kennen / Skill / Kennen / Skill / Kennen / Kennen. Power spikes were also described without a single cooldown.
audit.why: whys[0] says 'the range war is entirely his' at level 1; whys[2] opens with 'Skill:' at level 3; whys[3] says he kites and chips through 4-5. The chart contradicts the text sitting next to it.
audit.corrected: Both charts flipped as one atomic group, and Slicing Maelstrom's flat 120s, Lightning Rush's 10-to-6s and Thundering Shuriken's 950 range written into the phases.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. Smoke Screen is called a blind in five places — it reduces sight range and slows on impact, it never causes a miss, so the repeated line 'your blind does nothing to his ability damage' is arguing against a mechanic that does not exist. Separately, True Grit is said to do 'almost nothing against full-AP poke' — Graves' E grants Armor AND Magic Resist, so it is exactly the stat that blunts Kennen.
audit.why: Riot's text: Smoke Screen 'reduces sight range' with a Move Speed cut on impact; Quickdraw grants 'an Armor and Magic Resist boost'. The current page tells a Graves player his defensive dash is worthless in the one matchup where its MR half matters most.
audit.corrected: Blind claims replaced with the sight cut and slow — which genuinely help, since cutting Kennen's vision is how you break a 950-range poke pattern — and True Grit restated as a real answer to his damage that still cannot solve his range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightning Rush lets Kennen pass through units, and Graves' bullets cannot pass through units. Never stated anywhere.
audit.why: It is the exact mechanical reason a Kennen who rushes into you through the minion wave eats a fraction of the spread while you eat the full Mark stack — and the reason to fight him off to the side of the wave, not in it.
audit.corrected: Written into the early block and spikes[0].

edits.before: Four shells of buckshot win any level-1 face-off — trade autos point-blank where every pellet lands.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken outranges your spread at 950 and costs him 7s — concede level 1 and last-hit.

edits.before: E online — dash-reload weaving starts: auto, E for the grit armor and reset, auto again. Most champs lose this flat.
edits.after: E online at 16s and refunded by autos, but a 425 dash doesn't answer 950 poke — hold it as the escape, never the chase.

edits.before: Full kit: Q's wall-bounce return is your real damage — fight near terrain so both hits connect.
edits.after: Full kit: E in when he steps up to farm — but Lightning Rush is 10s and pulls him right back out.

edits.before: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track Lightning Rush; your armor stacks from E make his short trades unprofitable.
edits.after: True Grit gives magic resist as well as armor, so it does blunt his poke — but he still chips you from 950 and you can't reach him.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120 seconds — E in and dump Collateral Damage only while that is down.

edits.before: First item spike — the point-blank Q-AA-E-AA pattern now removes half bars. Force fights near walls.
edits.after: Your first item can't close 950 range — he kites on Lightning Rush speed and pokes you out first.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: He out-ranges and out-scales you — play for picks with smoke slows and R cones in jungle chokes.

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Your W smoke cuts sight range and slows on impact — drop it on the gank's arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.

edits.before: Play assassin-marksman: smoke their engage, E through fights for armor, and save R as either the execute or the peel knockback. Crit carries out-DPS you — picks don't care.
edits.after: Play assassin-marksman: smoke their engage for the slow and sight cut, E through fights for the MR, and save R as the execute. Kennen out-ranges you — picks don't care.

edits.before: His engage and escape — the stun chain starts here. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts his sight and slows on impact — it breaks a 950-range poke pattern better than it wins a trade.

edits.before: He pokes you with Q (Thundering Shuriken) and W (Electrical Surge) from outside point-blank shell range while your blind does nothing to his ability damage — the range war is entirely his.
edits.after: He pokes you with Q (Thundering Shuriken) at 950 and W (Electrical Surge) from outside point-blank shell range, and every hit stacks a Mark of the Storm toward a stun — the range war is entirely his.

edits.before: Still his window — he keeps poking from range and your W (Smoke Screen) blind is useless because his damage is abilities, not autos you could blind.
edits.after: Still his window — he keeps poking from range, and Smoke Screen cuts his sight and slows him but never stops an ability, so it buys you a retreat, not a trade.

edits.before: Your True Grit armor stacking does almost nothing against full-AP poke, so he just kites and chips you from range through 4-5.
edits.after: True Grit gives magic resist as well as armor, so his poke does get blunted — but he kites at 950 and chips you anyway through 4-5.

edits.before: Your only early opening: if Kennen walks up to last-hit a melee minion, E-dash in and unload the point-blank shell spread plus Q (End of the Line) before he Lightning Rushes (E) back to safety.
edits.after: Your only early opening: if Kennen walks up to last-hit, E-dash in beside the wave — your bullets can't pass through units — and unload the spread plus Q (End of the Line) before Lightning Rush (E) takes him out on its 10s cooldown.

edits.before: Kennen never lets you touch him — his Q (Thundering Shuriken) and W (Electrical Surge) poke you from outside point-blank shell range, and your W (Smoke Screen) blind is dead weight here because his whole kit is ability damage, not autos. Your only early window is Level 2-3: if he steps up to last-hit, E-dash in and dump the 4-shell spread plus Q before he Lightning Rushes (E) out. Don't burn E chasing into the open — without it you have no gap-closer and no escape, and every Q and W that lands also drops a Mark of the Storm toward a stun.
edits.after: Kennen never lets you touch him — his Q (Thundering Shuriken) reaches 950 and W (Electrical Surge) chips you from outside point-blank shell range, and Smoke Screen won't stop either: it cuts sight and slows, so use it to break his line on you, not to blank his damage. Your only early window is Level 2-3: if he steps up to last-hit, E-dash in beside the wave — bullets don't pass through units — and dump the spread plus Q before Lightning Rush (E) takes him out. Don't burn E chasing; every Q and W that lands stacks a Mark toward the stun.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 your True Grit armor/MR stacking does almost nothing — Kennen is full AP poke, so the bonus resists barely dent his damage and your W blind shuts off nothing. He just keeps chipping you from range. Level 6 is your single real swing: E onto him and unload Collateral Damage (R) plus the shell burst while his Slicing Maelstrom is down. Miss that window and his R channels AOE that stacks Mark of the Storm fast, the third proc stuns you mid-dash, and you eat the full chain. Bait his R or hold E until he commits Q.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 your True Grit stacks are worth more than they look — Quickdraw grants magic resist as well as armour, so dashing at him genuinely blunts the poke. What it can't fix is range: he chips you from 950 and you own no answer at 425. Level 6 is your single real swing: E onto him and unload Collateral Damage (R) plus the shell burst while Slicing Maelstrom, a flat 120 seconds, is down. Miss it and his R stacks Mark of the Storm fast, the third proc stuns you mid-dash, and you eat the chain. Hold E until he commits Q.

edits.before: Build three Mark of the Storm stacks to stun you mid-engage, then peel away on Lightning Rush (E) move speed
edits.after: Build three Mark of the Storm stacks to stun you mid-engage, then leave through the wave on Lightning Rush's unit-ignoring dash

notes: packet.suspectNames flags 'Lightning Rushes' as a probable wrong name — false positive, that is Lightning Rush used as a verb. The ownerKit derived flag on Graves' Q says 'creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes', which contradicts Riot's description ('detonates after 1 second, or after colliding with terrain'). End of the Line does not create terrain; I wrote nothing that depends on the flag, and the pre-existing 'Q's wall-bounce return' phrasing in phases[2].why has been replaced for the same reason.
